concept.title: Product and Inventory Management
concept.shortdesc: Product and inventory management enables store users to manage product information and track stock across branches.

conbody.p: Products represent items available for sale within a store. Each product includes information such as a name, SKU, price, category, image, and description.
Inventory tracks the quantity of a product at a specific branch. Inventory information includes the quantity, minimum stock level, and last restock timestamp.

section.title: Product Management
section.p: Product management provides operations for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching products.

section.title: Inventory Management
section.p: Inventory is maintained at the branch level. Users can create inventory records, update stock quantities, and retrieve inventory by branch or product.

section.title: Low-Stock Monitoring
section.p: The inventory system tracks the quantity of each product at a branch. When the available quantity reaches or falls below the configured minimum stock level, the product can be identified as low stock.
Store and branch users can use inventory information to monitor stock levels and determine when products need to be restocked.
